 Innodata stock falls as report flags layoffs in India, Philippines
 Less than 1 min read INOD Innodata INOD shares fell 16% to $49.88 in premarket trading Tuesday following reports that the company laid off nearly 550 employees in India on October 26, according to India Today. 
 Job cuts were also reported in the Philippines. Employees reported losing access to company laptops, official accounts, and HR systems before receiving termination emails through personal email accounts. 
 The termination notice cited a reduction in business assignments and stated that the decision was unrelated to individual performance. 
 The reports also said employees faced difficulties accessing payslips and other employment records after losing access to HR and payroll systems. 
 Innodata had 10.1K employees globally as of December 31, 2025, according to its annual report. However, the company has not publicly confirmed the reported layoff numbers or the full extent of the cuts.
